description_for_human: Real-time crypto intelligence API for Hyperliquid perpetuals. Multi-timeframe technical analysis, market sentiment, and funding rate data. Pay per query with USDC micropayments on Base or Solana (x402).
description_for_model: Cerebrus Pulse is a cryptocurrency analysis API that provides real-time multi-timeframe technical analysis (RSI, EMAs, ATR, Bollinger Bands, VWAP, Z-score, trend detection, confluence scoring), market sentiment, funding rates, open interest, spread/liquidity, and BTC-alt correlation data for 50+ Hyperliquid perpetual contracts. It uses x402 protocol for USDC micropayments on Base (chain ID 8453) or Solana (mainnet). The 402 response includes payment options for both chains — Base first, Solana second. Endpoints: GET /screener ($0.06) for market-wide scanning, GET /pulse/{coin} ($0.025) for technical analysis, GET /sentiment ($0.01) for market sentiment, GET /funding/{coin} ($0.01) for funding rates, GET /oi/{coin} ($0.015) for open interest analysis, GET /spread/{coin} ($0.015) for spread and liquidity, GET /correlation ($0.05) for BTC-alt correlation, GET /basis/{coin} ($0.02) for the perp premium, GET /cex-dex/{token} ($0.02) for CEX-DEX divergence, GET /depeg ($0.01) for USDC peg health, GET /liquidations/{coin} ($0.03) for modelled liquidation zones, GET /arb ($0.02) for the market stress index, GET /bundle/{coin} ($0.05) for pulse, 24h funding and sentiment in one call. Free endpoints: GET /health, GET /coins, GET /demo/{coin}. Supported timeframes: 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d, 1w. No API keys required — wallet is identity.

auth.instructions: Cerebrus Pulse uses x402 protocol for payment authentication. No API keys are needed. Your wallet address (Base or Solana) serves as your identity. The x402 SDK handles payment automatically: the server returns HTTP 402 with payment options for both Base and Solana, and the SDK signs a USDC micropayment on whichever chain your wallet is configured for. Install the x402 SDK for Python or TypeScript to get started.
